_note: PROPOSED tranche 2 fetch list. Nothing here has been downloaded. Every url, expected_producer and expected_bytes is an expectation from prior knowledge, NOT a measurement -- testkit/fetch_expansion.py records what actually arrives and reports each divergence. A candidate that 404s is reported as a failure and dropped, not guessed at. Restricted to licences that permit redistribution: US Government works (17 U.S.C. 105), IETF Trust TLP, and CC-BY/CC0. arXiv is deliberately absent: its default submission licence does not grant onward redistribution, so a paper qualifies only if its own abstract page declares CC-BY or CC0, which must be checked per paper and cannot be planned in advance.

candidates.why: NIST special publication: Word-to-Acrobat with running headers, footers and page-number fields -- the construct tranche 1 flagged as the dominant unmodelled one
second NIST document: dense requirement tables with a repeating header row across page breaks
FIPS 197: mathematical notation, matrices and monospaced hex tables in a government publication
Congressional Research Service report: Word-authored policy prose with footnotes and a summary page
GAO report: highlights page, running furniture, figures and a distinct agency template
IRS instructions: multi-column, worksheets, rules and shading from an in-house composition engine, well over the ordinary page ceiling
fillable AcroForm: the refusal contract has never been tested against a real interactive form, and this one is small
